# Cyber 72 welcome artwork

Asset: `dhaka-dusk.webp` (1672 × 941 pixels).

Created for Cyber 72 using the built-in image-generation tool on 8 November 2026. The generated PNG was converted to WebP for offline delivery. This is illustrated game key art; the title, particles, light, controls and loading miniature are separate code-rendered layers.

## Final generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic full-screen background key art for the web game Cyber 72, a Bangladeshi cyber-awareness adventure for teenagers. Create a premium polished 3D animated-adventure-game render, landscape 16:9 wide composition, rich dimensional materials and cinematic depth, not pixel art, not a flat illustration. Scene: a recognizably Old Dhaka inland street at blue-hour dusk, dense weathered colorful low-rise buildings, balcony grilles, overhead utility wires connected to roadside poles, tiny warm-lit Bengali neighborhood shop signs, a tea stall with a steaming kettle, a richly painted cycle rickshaw and green CNG, ordinary local people chatting and shopping deeper in the street, a small Bangladesh flag, a leafy rain tree. Warm amber shop lights against deep petrol teal and dusky blue, a soft sunset glow between the buildings, atmospheric fine dust catching the light. The main character Rakib is a friendly Bangladeshi late-teen boy with warm brown skin, natural expressive face, short black hair, a teal overshirt, dark indigo jeans and a warm tan canvas school backpack. He stands naturally in the RIGHT foreground around 76 percent across, three-quarter view towards the camera and left, visible from head to shoes, one hand holding a phone loosely near his hip. His proportions and hands are anatomically coherent. He is confidently curious rather than heroic or aggressive. Clear appealing silhouette, highly detailed fabric and nicely lit 3D face, soft golden rim light, good contact shadow. Composition essential: leave the LEFT 43 percent as quiet, darker softly defocused street architecture and deep teal atmosphere for a large game title and buttons to be overlaid in code. Concentrate the character, warm lights, rickshaw and street storytelling in the right 57 percent. Full bleed scene, no borders, no UI, no title, no logos, no English slogans or large typography. Small Bengali environmental lettering is fine. No guns, no battle, no masks, no river, no waterfront, no futuristic skyscrapers. The scene should feel like an inviting vibrant Dhaka adventure, with impressive realistic 3D depth and premium game key-art polish.
